title: Symmetries and continuous attractors in disordered neural circuits
title_zh: 混乱神经电路中的对称性与连续吸引子
abstract: A core challenge in neuroscience is reconciling idealized models with experimental data. Classical continuous-attractor models describe neural representations of continuous variables such as head direction. Symmetry in the weights generates a manifold of stable states, with tuning curves identical up to shifts. Rodent head-direction cells, by contrast, are markedly heterogeneous. Such heterogeneity, we show, is nevertheless compatible with these models. Here we build, directly from head-direction cell data, recurrent networks that behave as quasicontinuous attractors. A generative process then reproduces the heterogeneous tuning of these cells while making connectivity and dynamics tractable at large N. Although the weights appear disordered, they carry a circular symmetry whose eigenvalue degeneracies could signify continuous-attractor organization in connectome data. Dynamical mean-field theory recovers the ingredients of classical ring attractors, namely, Mexican hat interactions and a spontaneously broken symmetry producing bump states. Continuous-attractor mechanisms may thus operate in complex mammalian circuits. Head-direction cells are far more disorderly than classical continuous-attractor models allow. Clark et al. show that this disorder is nevertheless compatible with these models and that the underlying connectivity matrix hides a circular symmetry.
abstract_zh: 神经科学的核心挑战在于理想模型与实验数据之间的协调。经典的连续吸引子模型描述了头向等连续变量的神经表征。权重中的对称性生成了一组稳定态的流形，调谐曲线仅在平移下相同。然而，啮齿类头向细胞显示出显著的异质性。我们表明，这种异质性仍然与这些模型兼容。在此，我们直接从头向细胞数据构建了表现为准连续吸引子的循环网络。随后，一个生成过程重现这些细胞异质性的调谐曲线，同时在大规模N下使连接性和动力学可处理。尽管权重看似混乱，但它们携带一种圆对称性，其特征值的退化可能暗示连接组数据中连续吸引子的组织。动力学均场理论恢复了经典环吸引子的组成部分，即墨西哥帽相互作用和产生波峰态的自发对称性破缺。因此，连续吸引子机制可能在复杂的哺乳动物电路中运行。头向细胞比经典连续吸引子模型允许的更加混乱。Clark等人表明，这种混乱 nevertheless 与这些模型兼容，且底层的连接矩阵隐藏着圆对称性。
